result.title: Scheduling and intake desks
result.text: Appointments go through three desks after the referral review clears: hold the current slot through the hold desk (hold_slot), transmit the consented intake packet through the share desk (share_records, choosing one record_packets row), and confirm the appointment through the booking desk (book_appointment). The patient must separately approve the exact record packet and recipient, and then the exact appointment and estimate; at most one hold, one packet and one appointment; no payment. Stale slots are revalidated against live inventory at commit time.
